title: Practice: Lead Hook Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner named clip 2 the horizontal elbow. Words from the app: the Technique Library entry (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Lead Hook Elbow: cues, mistakes, next) and the Muay Thai path's Elbow lesson (practiceLessons.js › mt_elbow: calls), which this video also serves. Thai: Sok Tat (ศอกตัด), the cutting elbow. Footage: raw-footage/practice/p2.mp4 (ring, 2026-10-31): two reps facing the camera, then two from a 45° angle that show the swing-through.

props.description: The hook elbow from the lead side
props.hookSub: Lead hook elbow. Sok Tat. 20 seconds.

cues.label: STEP IN
cues.say: Coach: "An elbow needs hugging range. Get there first, then throw."

cues.text: Strike with the tip of the elbow
cues.label: THE TIP
cues.say: Coach: "The point of the elbow does the cutting. Not the forearm."

cues.label: SWING THROUGH
cues.say: Coach: "Don't stop at the face. The hip turns and the elbow keeps going."

watch.fix: Short and tight from the guard
watch.label: WIND-UP
watch.say: Coach: "If they see it coming, it's gone. It leaves from the guard, no backswing."
